purpose: Derive GW008 season 1 knockout trophy winners from final/latest matches
sql: SELECT r.competition_key,r.sm_action,r.sm_country,r.match_date,r.home_name,r.away_name,r.home_score,r.away_score,r.penalty_home_score,r.penalty_away_score,CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.penalty_home_score,-1)>COALESCE(r.penalty_away_score,-1) THEN r.home_name WHEN COALESCE(r.penalty_away_score,-1)>COALESCE(r.penalty_home_score,-1) THEN r.away_name WHEN r.home_score>r.away_score THEN r.home_name WHEN r.away_score>r.home_score THEN r.away_name ELSE NULL END AS winner FROM `GW008_IMC Results` r JOIN (SELECT competition_key,MAX(match_date) max_date FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield','smfacup','smfashield','supercup','worldcup') AND match_date BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-08-29' GROUP BY competition_key) x ON x.competition_key=r.competition_key AND x.max_date=r.match_date WHERE r.game_world_id='GW008' AND r.sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield','smfacup','smfashield','supercup','worldcup') ORDER BY r.competition_key,r.sm_fixture_id DESC
